desc: Precompute distinctPF[0..10^6] using sieve: for each prime p, increment distinctPF[m] for all multiples m of p.
Build best[0..10^6] where best[i] = i if distinctPF[i]==2 else best[i-1] (best[0]=best[1]=0).
Read Q and for each query A, compute s = isqrt(A), r = best[s], print r*r.
Verify with the provided sample (5 queries).
